claims.text: ROOT CAUSE 1: no ReplicaCache exists for any mesh pool. build_replica_caches (lobes/gateway/server.py:5814) returns {} when table.replica_origins is empty, which every real deployment has been since t14 deleted <PREFIX>_PEER_ORIGINS parsing (comment at server.py:5653-5657).

ROOT CAUSE 2: mesh candidates carry no load. _merge_mesh_candidates (server.py:2121) synthesizes every mesh peer with running=0, waiting=0, weight=8, calibrated=True; _maybe_synth_local_candidate (server.py:2157) synthesizes the local lane with running=0 too. Load is never observed for either side.

ROOT CAUSE 3: with every wait at 0, select_replica's _rank_key (lobes/gateway/_selection.py: wait, not-local, origin) sends everything to the local lane on a hosting box (reason local-idle) and to the lexically-smallest origin (http://spark...) on a non-hosting box, never spark2.

ROOT CAUSE 4: in-flight dispatch accounting (ReplicaCache.begin_dispatch/end_dispatch, _replicas.py:895-950) is reached via caches.get(backend) (server.py:5898, 5934). With no cache there is no accounting, so even a burst through ONE gateway is not spread.

When the mesh is enabled, the gateway builds a ReplicaCache for each hosted or mesh-pooled generate backend whose peer set is that role's mesh plain_origins (verified + fingerprint-agreeing, from compute_role_placement). The cache probes peer GET /status, which publishes running/waiting (server.py:3876-3889) and sits outside the /v1 auth gate (server.py:4720), so no new credential is needed.

hard_questions.text: Once a cache exists, _local_backend_fingerprint (server.py:4063) returns a LIVE local fingerprint instead of None, and compute_role_placement uses it as the reference. spark's compose hardcodes --speculative-config while spark2's comes from env (memory: spark-cortex-pooled-senses-dropped; the 2026-08-25 replica-pool transcript recorded speculative_config: unknown on both). Will the live fingerprints still agree, or will spark2 be demoted to cortex-spark2 and leave the pool, so the fix silently produces a pool of one?
